# Ensure we have an access token
try:
    token
    print('reusing_token', bool(token))
except NameError:
    spotify_pw = [a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
    token = apis.spotify.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']
    print('logged_in_new', bool(token))

# Fetch play_count for each unique song_id from album library
# (Recompute album library song_ids to avoid any lost state)
page_limit=20
all_albums=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('album_page', page_index, 'len', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_albums.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

all_song_ids=[]
for alb in all_albums:
    all_song_ids.extend(alb.get('song_ids', []))
unique_song_ids=sorted(set(all_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids_count', len(unique_song_ids))

song_stats=[]
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_stats.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': s['title'],
        'play_count': s.get('play_count', 0)
    })

# Compute max play_count
max_play = max(ss['play_count'] for ss in song_stats) if song_stats else None
candidates = [ss for ss in song_stats if ss['play_count']==max_play]
# Tie-break: smallest song_id
best = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x['song_id'])[0] if candidates else None

print('max_play_count', max_play)
print('candidates', [(c['song_id'], c['title']) for c in candidates])
print('best', best)
